title: Asset Intake Wizard, Map Composer, Palette & Workbench

resolution_required: asset-intake wizard flow over already-supplied/catalogued source and permission evidence
map composer interaction model that consumes presentation contracts without becoming World/Scene truth
palette and workbench behavior for permitted, denied, incompatible, missing and unresolved assets
manual asset assignment/override and explicit approved-placeholder/visibly-unresolved handling
permission/provenance presentation and diagnostics that do not infer rights or semantic compatibility
deterministic save/receipt or state-boundary behavior required by the bounded workbench contract
clear owner boundaries to MAI-09 runtime integration and existing World/Scene/Visibility/Combat/D29 domains
selection_contract.manual_rule: The workbench must preserve deliberate manual selection/override and make rejected, unresolved or placeholder states explicit rather than silently replacing them.
selection_contract.permission_rule: The UI may surface evidence and eligible choices but may not convert denied, unknown or unverified permission into allowed use.
selection_contract.acquisition_rule: Selection does not authorize provider download, purchase, authentication, scraping, payment or automatic acquisition; exact intake-source boundaries must be resolved before implementation.
selection_contract.owner_rule: Workbench composition may prepare presentation intent only. MAI-09 runtime integration and MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration remain separate owner truth.

preserved_boundaries: no vendor/editor/provider becomes canonical Multiversal map truth
no asset pack is assumed complete
semantic requirements remain separate from selected/available art
permissions and semantic compatibility are not inferred
manual assignment, approved-placeholder and visibly-unresolved outcomes remain first-class
MAI-08 may implement only after a future governed start and bounded workbench-contract resolution
MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration retain owner truth
migration 0022 remains unreserved absent demonstrated durable schema delta
no real-money commerce, tester distribution, release/deployment or provider/payment activation
next_action: Selection only. On the next owner Continue, freshly verify then-current AIOC/application heads, re-read completed MAI-01..07 evidence, resolve the exact asset-intake wizard, map-composer, palette and workbench contract and owner/permission/provenance boundaries, then governed-start MAI-08. Until then do not create an implementation branch or implement MAI-08 mechanics.
